=Initial node=

The initials node is used in [[Quests.yml]] to perform actions when the quest starts. 

Initials are laid out much like rewards. Here's an example:

<pre>initial:
    '0':
        type: item     # Gives an item when conditions are met.
        id: 268        # wooden_sword
        amount: 1   
        take: false    # Optional. By default, take: is false.
</pre>

You may have multiple initials.

=Initial Types=
==Command==

Command node (command:) - executes a command.
Specified by the command: node. Use <player> as a variable that will be replaced with the name of the player. Use <world> as a variable that will be replaced with the name of the world the player is currently in. Use server: true to execute the command from the console.

<pre>'0':
    type: command
    command: give <player> 1 100
    server: true
</pre>


==NPC==

NPC node (npc:) - grants an npc to a player.
Uses a name: node to specify the name of the npc, and a comma-separated list of toggles in the types: node (eg. trader,quester,guard). Will create an NPC owned by the player who started the quest, with a generated UID.

<pre>'0':
    type: npc
    npcid: 1   # optional - gives the ownership of npc specified by this id to the player
    name: 'Bill'
    types: 'guard,trader,quester'
    location:
        x: 10
        y: 10
        z: -50
        world: 'world'</pre>


==Rank==

Rank node (rank) - grants a group ('rank') to a player.
Specified by the rank: node.

<pre>'0':
    type: rank
    rank: 'admin'</pre>


==Permission==

Permission node (permission) - grants a permission to a player.
Specified by the permission: node.

<pre>'0':
    type: permission
    permission: 'quests.admin'
</pre>


==Item==

Item node (item) - gives an item to a player.
Loaded from the item: nodes.


<pre>'0':
    type: item
    item:
        id: 10
        amount: 50
        data: 0</pre>

==Health==

Health node (health) - gives health to a player.
Loaded from the amount: node.

<pre>
'0':
    type: health
    amount: 10
</pre>


==Money==

Money node (money) - gives money to a player.
Loaded from the money: node.

<pre>'0':
    type: money
    money: 100</pre>


==Teleport==

Teleport node (teleport) - teleports a player to a location.
Loaded from the location: node.

<pre>'0':
    type: teleport
    location:
        x: 10
        y: 50
        z: -10
        world: 'rivers'</pre>
